entries.42e7a1e975d3f9f8: In the medium-term plan, Step1, through the fiscal year ended January 2026, focuses on establishing the strategic foundation, and it began large-scale capital investment in the new Funabashi Plant and the Seishin No. 2 Plant, among others, to increase baked confectionery production. From the fiscal year ending January 2027, Step2 accelerates strategy execution, and from the fiscal year ending January 2030, Step3 brings full-scale growth; the plan has a 3-stage structure. Under the capital expenditure plan, construction of the new Funabashi Plant is scheduled for completion in January 2028, and renovation of the Seishin Plant is scheduled for completion in January 2029.

entries.658874c1ae2cdbbf: This business manufactures and sells dry confectionery, such as chocolates and cookies, fresh Western confectionery, such as cheesecakes and puddings, and other confectionery. Sales are made mainly directly, and the confectionery stores comprise 35 directly operated stores and 141 quasi-directly operated stores. Products are manufactured at the Seishin and Rokko Island plants in Kobe and the Funabashi plant in Funabashi, Chiba, among others; the consolidated subsidiary Kamakura New German Co., Ltd. also runs a Western confectionery manufacturing and sales business, and ＶＩＳＵＡＬ　ＨＯＮＧ　ＫＯＮＧ　ＬＩＭＩＴＥＤ in Hong Kong runs confectionery sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥34,199 million.
entries.65ee2559f2286692: This is a product group of chocolate, cookies, desserts and assorted gift sets. Main products include Premium Chocolate Selection, Fayage, Arcadia and Fancy Dessert, among others. Sales results for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥25,111 million.
entries.7c358e269d5a3ada: This is a product group of chilled desserts, cakes and semi-moist confections. Main products include custard pudding, cheesecake, madeleines and financiers, among others. Sales results for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥8,284 million.

entries.aa9e4533df17f4fc: Under the corporate slogan "Connecting Hearts. Shining Smiles.", it is pursuing the medium-term management plan "Tsunagu ～next stage 2031～", aimed at its 100th anniversary of founding in 2031. Placing "baked confectionery" at the center of its growth strategy, it aims to grow in 3 business areas: a master brand strategy for the core business, a product brand strategy for strategic businesses, and a new market strategy for new businesses. It also plans to work on cost control and productivity improvement, and on securing talent and improving employee satisfaction.
entries.ab2d8a71711c36f2: Sales are mainly direct. It has 35 company-operated and 141 quasi-company-operated confectionery shops, and 28 cafés. No specific sales counterparty accounts for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.af6a3ca985dfdb2b: It states that demand for "baked confectionery" is growing for everyday gifts regardless of season and as self-rewards, and that it is an area where the company can make use of strengths such as long-cultivated manufacturing technology and product development capabilities. It indicates a policy to strengthen it as a product that can fully exert competitive advantage in response to changing market conditions. It also cites making use of the brand assets of its traditional core brand "Morozoff".

entries.c016eb6e3356dbdc: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥36,273 million, up 0.7% year on year. By business, the Western Confectionery Manufacturing and Sales Business accounted for ¥34,199 million and the Café and Restaurant Business for ¥2,073 million.
entries.cafe3c9a5a1e5e3e: In sales results for the Western Confectionery Manufacturing and Sales Business for the fiscal year ended January 2026, dry confectionery accounted for the largest share at ¥25,111 million.
